sources: EDF 2025 Universal Registration Document (2 Apr 2026) section 1.4.5 pp.76-77: total cost about GBP35bn in 2015 money, Unit 1 in 2030; 'construction costs incurred, including capitalised interest, for the entire project amounted to EUR39.3 billion ... or GBP25.1 billion in 2015'; note 9.7 p.391: Unit 2 about 12 months after Unit 1 (https://www.edf.fr/sites/groupe/files/2026-04/2026-04-02-urd-edf-2025-en.pdf). EDF H1 2026 results (31 Jul 2026) leave cost and schedule unchanged. ONS CPI D7BT (2015=100): 2024 = 133.9 (https://www.ons.gov.uk/economy/inflationandpriceindices/timeseries/d7bt/mm23).
notes: Remaining = total less sunk (EDF base case; the risk case is GBP36bn). The completion price scales the project by modelled capacity over 3,260 MW, because the legacy valuation values the modelled unit's flows. Sunk cost is paid to the vendors (the compensation basis for an asset under construction); the remaining capex is financed at the public rate plus the graded construction premium for large-scale nuclear (workbook L-M, 0.5%).
